# Unit tests the fork's CI skips, one test path per line.
#
# Each of them talks to a public test network or a third-party server
# (Qtum testnet Electrum, a Cosmos test chain, an Ethereum node, Firo, public Electrum servers)
# and fails when that service is gone or no longer has the transaction the
# test looks for. They failed on the first Linux run of this fork without any
# change to the code they cover. None of them is on the UTXO path this fork
# is used for. Remove a line when its test runs offline or its service is back.
